questions.title: The WDL Number Sanctuary
questions.question: Your K-pop idol group has reached the Seattle survivor sanctuary! Before you can get supplies, they need your Washington Driver License number. What does your WDL number start with?
questions.explanation: Washington Driver License numbers start with 'WDL' followed by additional characters unique to each driver.
questions.imagePrompt: A neon-lit underground bunker entrance with K-pop posters and a scanner requiring ID

questions.title: The Stop Sign Standoff
questions.question: A horde of zombies is blocking an intersection! You see a red octagonal sign. Mya hisses nervously. What should you do?
questions.explanation: A red octagonal sign is a STOP sign. You must come to a complete stop, even during a zombie apocalypse!
questions.imagePrompt: A red stop sign at an intersection with shadowy zombie figures in the background

questions.title: Four-Way Zombie Frenzy
questions.question: You arrive at a four-way stop at the same time as another survivor vehicle. Gracie is frantically checking the map. Who has the right of way?
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, when two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the RIGHT has the right of way.
questions.imagePrompt: A four-way intersection with two cars and zombie silhouettes, one car clearly to the right

questions.title: School Zone Escape
questions.question: You're driving past an abandoned school (prime zombie hideout!) during what would be school hours. What is the maximum speed limit in a school zone when children might be present?
questions.explanation: In Washington, the speed limit in school zones when children are present is 20 mph.
questions.imagePrompt: An abandoned school with broken windows, a school zone sign showing 20 mph

questions.title: Curb Survival Parking
questions.question: You need to park The Pink Menace on a steep uphill to scavenge for supplies. Which way should you turn your wheels?
questions.explanation: When parking uphill WITH a curb, turn your wheels AWAY from the curb. If the car rolls, it will roll into the curb, not into traffic.
questions.imagePrompt: A pink car parked on a steep hill with wheels turned away from curb

questions.title: The Following Distance Dance
questions.question: A zombie flash mob just started ahead! How many seconds of following distance should you maintain behind the car in front of you in normal conditions?
questions.explanation: The recommended following distance in normal conditions is 3-4 seconds. Increase this in bad weather or when zombies are dancing in the road!
questions.imagePrompt: Cars on a road with a 3-4 second gap indicator and zombies doing choreography

questions.title: Brake Failure Breakout
questions.question: Oh no! Your brakes fail while being chased by a zombie horde! What should you do FIRST?
questions.explanation: If your brakes fail, first pump them rapidly to try to build pressure. Then downshift, use the emergency brake, and look for an escape route.
questions.imagePrompt: Dashboard view with brake warning light and zombie hands on the windshield

questions.title: Hydroplaning Horror
questions.question: It's raining heavily as you escape through Ohio. The Pink Menace starts to hydroplane! What should you do?
questions.correctAnswer: Ease off the gas and steer straight
questions.explanation: When hydroplaning, ease off the gas, don't brake suddenly, and steer straight until you regain traction.
questions.imagePrompt: A car on a rainy road with water spray, rain drops on windshield

questions.title: Headlight Protocol
questions.question: You're driving through the night to avoid zombie detection. When should you use your high beams?
questions.correctAnswer: On dark roads with no oncoming traffic
questions.explanation: Use high beams on dark roads when there's no oncoming traffic. Dim them within 500 feet of another vehicle.
questions.imagePrompt: A dark road illuminated by high beam headlights, stars visible

questions.title: Bicycle Lane Boundaries
questions.question: A survivor on a bicycle is using the bike lane to escape zombies. How much space should you give when passing them?
questions.explanation: When passing a cyclist, give them at least 3 feet of clearance. They're survivors too!
questions.imagePrompt: A car passing a cyclist with clear 3-foot gap marked, zombie in background
